narrative.northStar: One simple project, from source to live
narrative.overview: The approved design uses the existing vector logo, Inter typography and navy/ice identity. Real HTML examples carry the visual focus. Pale reading surfaces separate explanations from the dark source and hosting demonstrations.
keyCharacteristics: Readable source beside its rendered result.
Ice actions and selected states on navy.
A shared visual language for marketing and documentation.
dos: Do use the shared CSS tokens and existing SVG logo.
Do keep code readable, keyboard focus visible and demonstrations usable without scripts.
Do preserve documentation’s reading structure and native disclosure.
donts: Don’t turn the homepage’s composition into a requirement for every page.
Don’t invent benchmarks, customer claims or a public source-repository link.
Don’t imply that server setup provisions a cloud VM or that a coding agent is embedded in ItsyWeb.
